fields.title: Customer assistant gives unsafe account advice
fields.summary: Over six days the assistant told some customers they could skip a required payment verification. Eleven customers followed the advice.
fields.impact: Eleven customers delayed a required step; no funds were lost. Two complaints reached the regulator hotline.

timeline.event: Support lead escalates three similar tickets

containment: Feature restricted to read-only answers at 11:05 a.m.
Logs and prompt versions copied to the case folder before any change

classification.basis: Harm to customers was financial delay only; the role question (provider or deployer) is with counsel.

nextSteps: Counsel confirms which duties apply to our role
Re-run the evaluation set before re-enabling advice answers
